invariants.name: frontier_disjointness
invariants.description: In each synchronous BFS turn, the set of nodes occupied by pursuers and the set of nodes safely reached by the evader remain disjoint; once a node is occupied, the evader can never enter it without being intercepted.

invariants.name: turn_distance_equivalence
invariants.description: The synchronous multi-source BFS ensures that the number of turns equals the shortest-path distance from the initial positions of pursuers and evader respectively, turning the interception condition into a distance comparison (pursuer distance ≤ evader distance).
